verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official open-source CLI (ramp-public/ramp-cli), installable via curl script or Homebrew. It supports browser OAuth, client-credentials login for headless agents, human/agent profile switching, and an --agent JSON output mode plus --no-input for CI. It covers 12 resources, ships packaged agent skills such as agentic-purchase, and Ramp's AI-agent guide and llms.txt recommend it for coding agents and scripted loops. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI in real use (the only probe confirms the repo exists).
